_howTo: Studio news mirrored from Mom's Facebook. Newest first; shown on the Exhibitions & News page. image and link are optional.

text.zh: 分享《天地有大美》主視覺巨作〈江流浩蕩－伊瓜蘇瀑布〉（192×501 公分）：2019 年 8 月隨恩師羅振賢院長赴巴西與阿根廷交界的伊瓜蘇瀑布寫生，以畫筆記錄這份感動。展期至 11/1。
text.en: The centerpiece of “The Great Beauty of Heaven and Earth”: “Mighty Waters – Iguazu Falls” (192 × 501 cm), born of a sketching trip to Iguazu Falls on the Brazil–Argentina border with her teacher Luo Zhen-xian in August 2019. On view through November 1.

text.zh: 接受台灣廣播公司中興電台黃畹真台長專訪，暢談《天地有大美》袁之靜水墨創作展。展期至 11/1，歡迎把握時間參觀。
text.en: A radio interview with the director of BCC Zhongxing Radio about “The Great Beauty of Heaven and Earth,” on view through November 1.

text.zh: 10/17（六）上午 10:30 現場導覽！《天地有大美》展期到 11/1 即將截止，歡迎把握時間前往彰化生活美學館參觀。
text.en: Artist-led tour Saturday, October 17, 10:30 a.m. “The Great Beauty of Heaven and Earth” closes November 1 — last chance to visit.

text.zh: 在國立彰化生活美學館與國美館館長陳貺怡對談「天地之美，心源之境」，談水墨的傳承、轉化與心靈表現。
text.en: A public conversation with Chen Kuang-yi, Director of the National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts, at the National Changhua Living Art Center, on tradition, transformation, and the inner life of ink painting.

text.zh: 《天地有大美》開幕茶會圓滿舉行，逾 300 位貴賓與好友到場，感謝大家的支持與鼓勵。
text.en: Over 300 guests joined the opening reception of “The Great Beauty of Heaven and Earth.” Thank you all for your support.

text.zh: 《天地有大美》2026 袁之靜水墨創作展開幕！63 件新作首度公開，展期至 11 月 1 日，國立彰化生活美學館第一、二展覽室。
text.en: “The Great Beauty of Heaven and Earth” is open: 63 new works, on view through November 1 at the National Changhua Living Art Center, Galleries 1 & 2.

text.zh: 《上善若水》臺中榮總創作展圓滿結束，感謝院方與大家的支持。
text.en: “The Highest Good Is Like Water” at Taichung Veterans General Hospital has closed. Thank you to the hospital and everyone who visited.

text.zh: 《上善若水》2026袁之靜水墨創作展在臺中榮民總醫院舉行開幕暨捐贈儀式。主視覺〈上善若水－浩瀚伊瓜蘇〉以萬瀑奔流，感謝醫者仁心如水、救人濟世。展期至 7/1，門診前棟 2 樓大廳。
text.en: Opening and donation ceremony for “The Highest Good Is Like Water” at Taichung Veterans General Hospital. The centerpiece, “The Highest Goodness: Boundless Iguazu,” is a tribute to the doctors whose care, like water, sustains all it touches. On view through July 1 in the Outpatient Building 2F lobby.

text.zh: 《初心·出新》袁之靜師生書畫展在部立豐原醫院開展，師生共 47 件作品，展至 2 月底。
text.en: “Original Heart, New Brush,” an exhibition with her students, opens at Fengyuan Hospital: 47 works, through the end of February.

text.zh: 《遇見．武陵》袁之靜水墨創作展在武陵富野渡假村開幕，60 餘件作品伴隨櫻花季展至隔年 3 月底。
text.en: “Encountering Wuling” opens at Fuye Resort Wuling: 60+ works on view through the cherry-blossom season to the end of March.
